scope: UK ChargePoint CMS 323 stations, access cross-check (not tariff validation)

groups.evidence: Official Bristol Airport staff travel guide states Lulsgate House car park EV charging is currently only available to BAL staff; planning docs distinguish staff-only EV bays.

University of South Wales states its EV charge points are not available for public use (ChargePoint+); source stations are on Cardiff Atrium, G Block, Sports Park and Glyntaff campuses. Names and postcodes support association; exact individual hardware membership is inferred from site matching.
Hull University confirms visitors can park and limited campus EV charging first come first served; none of four ChargePoint source station IDs is individually named by the university.
